title: GIRL FRIENDS
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shy top student Mari Kumakura is befriended by outgoing Akko Oohashi, who draws her into fashion, friends and a livelier school life. The group's high-school years include alcohol, boys, diets and studies. Mari, and later Akko, realize their feelings for each other go beyond friendship, and the two must decide whether to risk their bond by becoming a couple.
life_message: Love is worth the risk of honesty, even when it changes a precious friendship.
